New app icon and logo.

*Nyt app-ikon og logo.*

## Changes

- **New icon** on macOS, Windows and Linux: the Soundstave "S" – a musical staff with notes
  and a sound wave – on a rounded tile.
- The full Soundstave logo is shown at the top of the README.
- The Linux package installs the icon in all standard sizes (16–512 px).

## Downloads

| Platform | Installer | Portable |
|---|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel) | `Soundstave-0.2.2-macos-universal.dmg` – open and drag *Soundstave* to *Applications* | `…-macos-universal.zip` |
| Windows (64-bit) | `Soundstave-0.2.2-windows-x64-setup.exe` | `…-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (Debian/Ubuntu, x86-64) | `soundstave_0.2.2_amd64.deb` – `sudo apt install ./soundstave_0.2.2_amd64.deb` | `…-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The apps are not signed by Apple or Microsoft:

- **macOS:** the first time, right-click the app → *Open*. On macOS 15 or later, open
  *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway*.
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen appears, click *More info* → *Run anyway*.
